arm: D-1e full angular harmonic spectrum on the K-092 seed set

scope.licence: K-096 first-move licence; already-seen set; D-7 STRUCK

why: a signed directional test reports null exactly when a SYMMETRIC mechanism is total: ten from the left and ten from the right gives R1 = 0 and R2 = 1. This arm measures which harmonic carries the concentration instead of assuming one.
what_was_already_covered: D-1c BEARING_R2 and D-1d BEARING_RESID_R2 were BOTH already order-2 statistics on the bearing relative to strike, so those nulls stand for the symmetric case. Never tested before now: order 1, order 3, order 4 (conjugate shear), the body azimuths at any order, and the elevation parity split.

declaration.null: waveform-matched time-uniform (engine/dwell_null.py); a uniform-circle null would manufacture an effect

dominant.meaning: DIRECTIONAL: pull from one side differs from pull from the opposite side
dominant.why_lowest_not_largest: an order-k symmetry implies every multiple of k, so the argmax over orders picks a multiple at random among ties and names the wrong mechanism; the fundamental order is the smallest one carrying it
dominant.caution: a dominant order is a DESCRIPTION until it is calibrated against a waveform-matched null and corrected for having examined every order; orders 3, 5 and 6 have no standard tidal mechanism and should be read as artifact first

dominant.meaning: AXIAL: left/right equivalent, 180 deg fundamental domain -- where a symmetric mechanism lives, and where a first-moment test is blind

calibration.p_convention: Phipson-Smyth exact: (#{null >= observed} + 1)/(N + 1). Ties count against significance; p is never exactly zero.
calibration.dependence: handled implicitly -- the null replicates carry the same correlation among statistics that the observation does, so it is reproduced rather than modelled

not_evidence: selected set. A null extends the bound into the symmetric and higher-order directions; a hit is a reason to build the lattice, not a finding.

the_demonstration.headline: The bearing of tidal extension relative to fault strike has an order-1 resultant of 0.7451 on 162 events. Against a uniform-circle null that is z = +19, which would be the largest 'discovery' this program has ever produced. Against the waveform-matched null it is z = +1.52 -- nothing. The tidal bearing at a fixed site is ALREADY strongly concentrated (null E[R] = 0.7107), and a uniform-circle null does not know that. This is section P7-25(5) K-096(ii) in one number: reading an azimuth concentration against a uniform circle would be D-1's exact error in a new coordinate.
